checks.label: initial
checks.coverage: All eight binary input combinations in forward and reverse order; arithmetic oracle; mismatch fatal and bounded timeout.

limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
No synthesis or board work performed.
implementation: Combinational one-bit full adder with original TopModule ports. XOR sum and majority carry; no added ports or latency.
static_review: Single continuous driver per output, complete combinational equations, one-bit operands and outputs; arithmetic test oracle uses integer addition and compares two result bits.
